outbox_event_email_payload.name: outbox_event_email_payload
outbox_event_email_payload.value:
(
        ("outbox_event"."email_template" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_locale" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_recipient" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_first_name" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_title" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_deadline" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" IS NULL AND "outbox_event"."email_sender" IS NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_message" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("outbox_event"."email_template" IS NOT NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_template" IN (
            'invitation', 'reminder', 'approval', 'escalation', 'supplier_invitation', 'survey',
            'mention'
          )
          AND "outbox_event"."email_locale" IS NOT NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_locale" IN ('de', 'en')
          AND "outbox_event"."email_recipient" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("outbox_event"."email_recipient")) > 0
          AND "outbox_event"."email_title" IS NOT NULL
          AND length(trim("outbox_event"."email_title")) > 0
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" IS NOT NULL
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" LIKE '/%'
          AND "outbox_event"."email_link" NOT LIKE '//%'
          AND position('?' in "outbox_event"."email_link") = 0
          AND position('#' in "outbox_event"."email_link") = 0
          AND position(chr(92) in "outbox_event"."email_link") = 0)
      )

comment_body.name: comment_body
comment_body.value:
("comment"."deleted_at" is null and length(trim("comment"."body")) between 1 and 2000)
        or ("comment"."deleted_at" is not null and "comment"."body" = '')

initiative_share_summe.name: initiative_share_summe
initiative_share_summe.value: "initiative_share"."buyer_share_pct" between 0 and 100 and "initiative_share"."supplier_share_pct" between 0 and 100 and "initiative_share"."buyer_share_pct" + "initiative_share"."supplier_share_pct" = 100

segment_decision_target.name: segment_decision_target
segment_decision_target.value:
("segment_decision"."scope" = 'total' and "segment_decision"."business_unit_id" is null) or
        ("segment_decision"."scope" = 'bu_mg' and "segment_decision"."business_unit_id" is not null)

segment_decision_levels.name: segment_decision_levels
segment_decision_levels.value:
"segment_decision"."ist_impact_level" between 1 and 3 and "segment_decision"."ist_quality_level" between 1 and 3
        and "segment_decision"."soll_impact_level" between 1 and 3 and "segment_decision"."soll_quality_level" between 1 and 3

segmentation_round_model_version.name: segmentation_round_model_version
segmentation_round_model_version.value:
("segmentation_round"."status" = 'draft' and "segmentation_round"."model_version" is null) or
        ("segmentation_round"."status" in ('open', 'closed') and "segmentation_round"."model_version" > 0)

rule_set_approved.name: rule_set_approved
rule_set_approved.value: ("rule_set"."status" = 'draft') = ("rule_set"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "rule_set"."approved_by" IS NULL AND "rule_set"."approved_by_name" IS NULL)

rule_set_item_shape.name: rule_set_item_shape
rule_set_item_shape.value: ("rule_set_item"."kind" = 'format') = ("rule_set_item"."group" IS NULL AND "rule_set_item"."cadence" IS NOT NULL)

segment_model_activation.name: segment_model_activation
segment_model_activation.value:
("segment_model"."status" = 'draft' and "segment_model"."activated_at" is null) or
        ("segment_model"."status" in ('active', 'retired') and "segment_model"."activated_at" is not null)

plan_contribution_one_reference.name: plan_contribution_one_reference
plan_contribution_one_reference.value:
("plan_contribution"."business_unit_id" is not null and "plan_contribution"."material_group_id" is null) or
        ("plan_contribution"."business_unit_id" is null and "plan_contribution"."material_group_id" is not null)

plan_objective_one_reference.name: plan_objective_one_reference
plan_objective_one_reference.value:
("plan_objective"."business_unit_id" is not null and "plan_objective"."material_group_id" is null) or
        ("plan_objective"."business_unit_id" is null and "plan_objective"."material_group_id" is not null)

touchpoint_texts.name: touchpoint_texts
touchpoint_texts.value: length(trim("touchpoint"."buyer_name")) between 1 and 120 and length(trim("touchpoint"."supplier_name")) between 1 and 120 and length(trim("touchpoint"."format")) between 1 and 120

supplier_financial_unit.name: supplier_financial_unit
supplier_financial_unit.value:
case when "supplier_financial"."metric" in ('ebit_margin', 'equity_ratio')
        then "supplier_financial"."unit" = 'basis_points' and "supplier_financial"."currency" is null
        else "supplier_financial"."unit" = 'cents' and "supplier_financial"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$' end

supplier_profile_werte.name: supplier_profile_werte
supplier_profile_werte.value: ("supplier_profile"."founded_year" is null or "supplier_profile"."founded_year" between 1600 and 2100) and ("supplier_profile"."employees" is null or "supplier_profile"."employees" >= 0)
